name: AgentDock / AgentDock Pro
description: Runs the AgentDock desktop app (AppImage you provide through a shared folder) inside the isolated desktop, driving the agent CLIs installed in the agent. AgentDock spawns CLIs locally, so isolation applies to everything it runs.
instruction: ls ~/shared/*/AgentDock*.AppImage >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec ~/shared/*/AgentDock*.AppImage --no-sandbox || echo 'Share a folder containing the AgentDock AppImage with this agent first.'
